Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Import Lia.

Inductive typ :=
  | int : typ
  | top : typ
  | and : typ -> typ -> typ
  | rcd : nat -> typ -> typ
  | arr : typ -> typ -> typ.

Inductive mode := inf | chk.

Inductive fmode := bl | wh.

Inductive exp :=
  | lit : nat -> exp
  | unit : exp
  | ctx : exp
  | merge : exp -> exp -> exp
  | ann : exp -> typ -> exp
  | rec : nat -> exp -> exp
  | proj : exp -> nat -> exp
  | lam : fmode -> exp -> exp
  | app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | box : exp -> exp -> exp.

Inductive sub : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
  | sint  : sub int int
  | stop  : forall A, sub A top
  | sand  : forall A B C, sub A B -> sub A C -> sub A (and B C)
  | sandl : forall A B C, sub A C -> sub (and A B) C
  | sandr : forall A B C, sub B C -> sub (and A B) C
  | srcd  : forall x A B, sub A B -> sub (rcd x A) (rcd x B)
  | sarr  : forall A B C D, sub C A -> sub B D -> sub (arr A B) (arr C D).

Inductive gord : typ -> Prop :=
  | GO_int :
      gord int
  | GO_arrow : forall A B,
      gord B ->
      gord (arr A B)
  | GO_rcd : forall x B,
      gord B ->
      gord (rcd x B).

Definition cost_spec A B := exists C, gord C /\ sub A C /\ sub B C.

Definition disjoint A B := ~ (cost_spec A B).

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | vlit : forall i, value (lit i)
  | vunit : value unit
  | vmrg : forall e1 e2, value e1 -> value e2 -> value (merge e1 e2)
  | vrec : forall x e, value e -> value (rec x e)
  | vclos : forall e1 e A B, value e1 -> value (box e1 (ann (lam bl e) (arr A B)))
  | vsclos : forall e1 e A B l, value e1 -> value (box e1 (ann (lam wh e) (arr (rcd l A) B))).

Inductive genv : typ -> exp -> Prop :=
  | genv_top : genv top unit
  | genv_arr : forall A B v,
      genv B v ->
      genv (arr A B) (box unit (ann (lam bl v) (arr A B)))
  | genv_and : forall A B v1 v2, genv A v1 -> genv B v2 -> genv (and A B) (merge v1 v2)
  | genv_rcd : forall A l v, genv A v -> genv (rcd l A) (rec l v).

Inductive ord : typ -> Prop :=
  | O_int :
      ord int
  | O_arrow : forall A B,
      ord (arr A B)
  | O_rcd : forall x B,
      ord (rcd x B).

Inductive toplike : typ -> Prop :=
  | TL_top :
      toplike top
  | TL_and : forall A B,
      toplike A ->
      toplike B ->
      toplike (and A B)
  | TL_arr : forall (A B:typ),
      toplike B ->
      toplike (arr A B)
  | TL_rcd : forall x (B:typ),
      toplike B ->
      toplike (rcd x B).

Inductive ext : typ -> fmode -> typ -> Prop :=
  | ext_bl: forall A, ext A bl A
  | ext_wh: forall x A, ext (rcd x A) wh A.

Inductive casting : exp -> typ -> exp -> Prop :=
  | cast_top  : forall v, casting v top unit
  | cast_int  : forall i, casting (lit i) int (lit i)
  | cast_mrgl : forall v1 v2 A v1',
      casting v1 A v1' ->
      ord A ->
      casting (merge v1 v2) A v1'
  | cast_mrgr : forall v1 v2 A v2',
      casting v2 A v2' ->
      ord A ->
      casting (merge v1 v2) A v2'
  | cast_and : forall v v1 v2 A B,
      casting v A v1 ->
      casting v B v2 ->
      casting v (and A B) (merge v1 v2)
  | cast_rcd : forall v A v' x,
      casting v A v' ->
      casting (rec x v) (rcd x A) (rec x v')
  | cast_arr : forall e v A B C D A' fm,
      value v ->
      ~ toplike D ->
      ext A fm A' ->
      sub C A' ->
      sub B D ->
      casting (box v (ann (lam fm e) (arr A B))) (arr C D) (box v (ann (lam fm e) (arr A D)))
  | cast_arr_tl : forall e v A B C D v' fm A',
      value v ->
      toplike D ->
      ext A fm A' ->
      sub C A' ->
      sub B D ->
      genv (arr C D) v' ->
      casting (box v (ann (lam fm e) (arr A B))) (arr C D) v'.

Definition consistencySpec v1 v2 :=
  forall A v1' v2', casting v1 A v1' -> casting v2 A v2' -> v1' = v2'.

Inductive has_type : typ -> exp -> mode -> typ -> Prop :=
  | tlit : forall G i, has_type G (lit i) inf int
  | tunit : forall G, has_type G unit inf top
  | tctx : forall G, has_type G ctx inf G
  | tmrg : forall G e1 e2 A B,
      has_type G e1 inf A ->
      has_type (and G A) e2 inf B ->
      disjoint A B ->
      disjoint G A ->
      has_type G (merge e1 e2) inf (and A B)
  | tcon : forall G v1 v2 A B,
      has_type G v1 inf A ->
      has_type G v2 inf B ->
      value v1 ->
      value v2 ->
      consistencySpec v1 v2->
      has_type G (merge v1 v2) inf (and A B)
  | tann : forall G e A,
      has_type G e chk A ->
      has_type G (ann e A) inf A
  | tlam : forall A e B G C fm A',
      disjoint G A ->
      ext A fm A' ->
      sub C A' ->
      has_type (and G A) e chk B ->
      has_type G (ann (lam fm e) (arr A B)) inf (arr C B)
  | tapp : forall G e1 e2 A B,
      has_type G e1 inf (arr A B) ->
      has_type G e2 chk A ->
      has_type G (app e1 e2) inf B
  | tbox : forall e1 e2 A B G,
      has_type G e1 inf B ->
      has_type B e2 inf A ->
      has_type G (box e1 e2) inf A
  | tsub : forall G e A B,
      has_type G e inf A ->
      sub A B ->
      has_type G e chk B
  | trec : forall G e x A,
      has_type G e inf A ->
      has_type G (rec x e) inf (rcd x A)
  | tproj : forall G e x A,
      has_type G e inf (rcd x A) ->
      has_type G (proj e x) inf A.

Inductive constr : typ -> exp -> fmode -> exp -> Prop :=
  | constr_bl: forall A v, constr A v bl v
  | constr_wh: forall x A v, constr (rcd x A) v wh (rec x v).

Inductive step : exp -> exp -> exp -> Prop :=
  | step_ctx : forall v, value v -> step v ctx v
  | step_annv : forall v v1 A v1', value v -> casting v1 A v1' -> value v1 -> step v (ann v1 A) v1'
  | step_anne : forall v e e' A, step v e e' -> step v (ann e A) (ann e' A)
  | step_mrgr : forall v e e' v1, step (merge v v1)  e e' -> value v1 -> step v (merge v1 e) (merge v1 e')
  | step_mrgl : forall v e1 e1' e2, step v e1 e1' -> step v (merge e1 e2) (merge e1' e2)
  | step_rcde : forall v e' e x, step v e e' -> step v (rec x e) (rec x e')
  | step_projv : forall v v1 x, value v -> value v1 -> step v (proj (rec x v1) x) v1
  | step_proje : forall v e' e x, step v e e' -> step v (proj e x) (proj e' x)
  | step_switch : forall v e A B fm,
      value v ->
      step v (ann (lam fm e) (arr A B)) (box v (ann (lam fm e) (arr A B)))
  | step_beta : forall v v1 A B v1' e v2 A' fm v3,
      ext A fm A' ->
      casting v1 A' v1' ->
      value v ->
      value v1 ->
      value v2 ->
      constr A v1' fm v3 ->
      step v (app (box v2 (ann (lam fm e) (arr A B))) v1) (box (merge v2 v3) (ann e B))
  | step_appl : forall v e1 e1' e2, step v e1 e1' -> step v (app e1 e2) (app e1' e2)
  | step_appr : forall v v1 e2 e2', step v e2 e2' -> value v1 -> step v (app v1 e2) (app v1 e2')
  | step_boxv : forall v v1 v2, value v -> value v1 -> value v2 -> step v (box v1 v2) v2
  | step_boxe : forall e e' v v1,
      step v1 e e' ->
      value v ->
      ~ value (box v1 e) ->
      step v (box v1 e) (box v1 e')
  | step_boxc : forall e1 e2 v e,
      step v e1 e2 ->
      value v ->
      step v (box e1 e) (box e2 e).

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Lia.

Require Import Language.

Fixpoint size_typ (A1 : typ) {struct A1} : nat :=
  match A1 with
    | int => 1
    | top => 1
    | arr A2 B1 => 1 + (size_typ A2) + (size_typ B1)
    | and A2 B1 => 1 + (size_typ A2) + (size_typ B1)
    | rcd l1 A2 => 1 + (size_typ A2)
  end.

Fixpoint size_exp (e1 : exp) {struct e1} : nat :=
  match e1 with
    | unit => 1
    | lit i1 => 1
    | ctx => 1
    | merge e2 e3 => 1 + (size_exp e2) + (size_exp e3)
    | ann e2 A1 => 1 + (size_exp e2) + (size_typ A1)
    | rec l1 e2 => 1 + (size_exp e2)
    | proj e2 l1 => 1 + (size_exp e2)
    | lam fm e2 => 1 + (size_exp e2)
    | app e2 e3 => 1 + (size_exp e2) + (size_exp e3)
    | box e2 e3 => 1 + (size_exp e2) + (size_exp e3)
  end.

Definition relation (X:Type) := X -> X -> Prop.

Section Star.

Variable A : Type.

Variable R : relation A.

Inductive star: relation A:=
  | star_refl: forall a,
      star a a
  | star_step: forall a b c,
      R a b -> star b c -> star a c.

Definition irred a : Prop := forall b, ~(R a b).

End Star.

Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Lia.
Require Import Language Infra.

(* ================= basic subtyping ================= *)

Lemma size_typ_ge1 : forall A, 1 <= size_typ A.
Proof. induction A; simpl; lia. Qed.

Lemma sub_refl : forall A, sub A A.
Proof. induction A; eauto using sub. Qed.

Lemma sub_top_gen : forall A C, sub top C -> sub A C.
Proof.
  intros A C H. remember top as T eqn:ET.
  revert A. induction H; intros A0; subst; try discriminate.
  - apply stop.
  - apply sand; [ apply IHsub1 | apply IHsub2 ]; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sub_and_inv : forall A T, sub A T -> forall X Y, T = and X Y -> sub A X /\ sub A Y.
Proof.
  intros A T H. induction H; intros X Y E; try discriminate.
  - injection E as h1 h2. subst. split; assumption.
  - subst. destruct (IHsub X Y eq_refl) as [h1 h2]. split; eauto using sub.
  - subst. destruct (IHsub X Y eq_refl) as [h1 h2]. split; eauto using sub.
Qed.

(* ================= genv structure ================= *)

Lemma genv_functional : forall A v1, genv A v1 -> forall v2, genv A v2 -> v1 = v2.
Proof.
  intros A v1 H. induction H; intros v2 H2; inversion H2; subst; try reflexivity.
  - assert (e = e0) as -> by (apply IHHgenv; assumption). reflexivity.
  - assert (v = v0) as -> by (apply IHHgenv; assumption). reflexivity.
  - assert (v = v0) as -> by (apply IHHgenv; assumption). reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma genv_toplike : forall A v, genv A v -> toplike A.
Proof.
  intros A v H. induction H.
  - apply TL_top.
  - apply TL_arr. assumption.
  - apply TL_and; assumption.
  - apply TL_rcd. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma sub_toplike : forall A B, sub A B -> toplike A -> toplike B.
Proof.
  intros A B H. induction H; intros ht.
  - inversion ht.
  - apply TL_top.
  - apply TL_and; [ apply IHsub1 | apply IHsub2 ]; assumption.
  - inversion ht. apply IHsub. assumption.
  - inversion ht. apply IHsub. assumption.
  - inversion ht. apply TL_rcd. apply IHsub. assumption.
  - inversion ht. apply TL_arr. apply IHsub. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma toplike_and_inv : forall A B, toplike (and A B) -> toplike A /\ toplike B.
Proof. intros A B H. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma toplike_arr_inv : forall A B, toplike (arr A B) -> toplike B.
Proof. intros A B H. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma toplike_rcd_inv : forall x A, toplike (rcd x A) -> toplike A.
Proof. intros x A H. inversion H; subst; auto. Qed.

Lemma sub_top_gord_false : forall C, gord C -> sub top C -> False.
Proof.
  intros C Hg. induction Hg; intros Hs.
  - inversion Hs.
  - inversion Hs. inversion H2.
  - inversion Hs. inversion H2.
Qed.

Lemma disjoint_top_l : forall A, disjoint top A.
Proof.
  intros A [C [Hg [H1 H2]]]. eapply sub_top_gord_false; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma disjoint_top_r : forall A, disjoint A top.
Proof.
  intros A [C [Hg [H1 H2]]]. eapply sub_top_gord_false; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma non_toplike_gord : forall A, ~ toplike A -> exists D, gord D /\ sub A D.
Proof.
  induction A as [ | | A1 A2 IHA1 IHA2 | l A0 IHA | A1 A2 IHA1 IHA2]; intros hnt.
  - exists int. split; [ apply GO_int | apply sint ].
  - exfalso. apply hnt. apply TL_top.
  - destruct (toplike_dec A1) as [h1 | h1].
    + destruct (toplike_dec A2) as [h2 | h2].
      * exfalso. apply hnt. apply TL_and; assumption.
      * destruct (IHA2 h2) as [D [Hg Hs]]. exists D. split; [ assumption | ].
        apply sandr. assumption.
    + destruct (IHA1 h1) as [D [Hg Hs]]. exists D. split; [ assumption | ].
      apply sandl. assumption.
  - destruct (IHA (fun h => hnt (TL_rcd l A0 h))) as [D [Hg Hs]].
    exists (rcd l D). split; [ apply GO_rcd; assumption | apply srcd; assumption ].
  - destruct (IHA2 (fun h => hnt (TL_arr A1 A2 h))) as [D [Hg Hs]].
    exists (arr A1 D). split; [ apply GO_arrow; assumption | ].
    apply sarr; [ apply sub_refl | assumption ].
Qed.
EOF

(* ================= canonical gord supertype ================= *)

Fixpoint toplike_decS (A : typ) : {toplike A} + {~ toplike A}.
Proof.
  destruct A as [ | | A1 A2 | l A0 | A1 A2].
  - right. intro H. inversion H.
  - left. apply TL_top.
  - destruct (toplike_decS A1) as [h1 | h1].
    + destruct (toplike_decS A2) as [h2 | h2].
      * left. apply TL_and; assumption.
      * right. intro H. inversion H. tauto.
    + right. intro H. inversion H. tauto.
  - destruct (toplike_decS A0) as [h | h].
    + left. apply TL_rcd. assumption.
    + right. intro H. inversion H. tauto.
  - destruct (toplike_decS A2) as [h | h].
    + left. apply TL_arr. assumption.
    + right. intro H. inversion H. tauto.
Defined.

Fixpoint gsup (A : typ) : typ :=
  match A with
  | int => int
  | top => top
  | and A1 A2 =>
      if toplike_decS A1 then (if toplike_decS A2 then top else gsup A2) else gsup A1
  | rcd l A0 => rcd l (gsup A0)
  | arr A1 A2 => arr A1 (gsup A2)
  end.

Lemma toplike_not_and : forall A B, ~ toplike (and A B) -> ~ toplike A \/ ~ toplike B.
Proof.
  intros A B H. destruct (toplike_decS A) as [ha | ha]; destruct (toplike_decS B) as [hb | hb].
  - exfalso. apply H. apply TL_and; assumption.
  - right. assumption.
  - left. assumption.
  - left. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma gsup_gord : forall A, ~ toplike A -> gord (gsup A).
Proof.
  induction A; simpl; intros h.
  - apply GO_int.
  - exfalso. apply h. apply TL_top.
  - destruct (toplike_decS A1) as [h1 | h1].
    + destruct (toplike_decS A2) as [h2 | h2].
      * exfalso. apply h. apply TL_and; assumption.
      * apply IHA2. assumption.
    + apply IHA1. assumption.
  - apply GO_rcd. apply IHA. intro hh. apply h. apply TL_rcd. assumption.
  - apply GO_arrow. apply IHA2. intro hh. apply h. apply TL_arr. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma gsup_sub : forall A, ~ toplike A -> sub A (gsup A).
Proof.
  induction A; simpl; intros h.
  - apply sint.
  - exfalso. apply h. apply TL_top.
  - destruct (toplike_decS A1) as [h1 | h1].
    + destruct (toplike_decS A2) as [h2 | h2].
      * exfalso. apply h. apply TL_and; assumption.
      * apply sandr. apply IHA2. assumption.
    + apply sandl. apply IHA1. assumption.
  - apply srcd. apply IHA. intro hh. apply h. apply TL_rcd. assumption.
  - apply sarr; [ apply sub_refl | apply IHA2 ]. intro hh. apply h. apply TL_arr. assumption.
Qed.

(* cost_spec introductions *)
Lemma cost_and_l : forall T1 T2 B, cost_spec T1 B -> cost_spec (and T1 T2) B.
Proof. intros T1 T2 B [D [Hg [H1 H2]]]. exists D. split; [ assumption | split ]; [ apply sandl; assumption | assumption ]. Qed.

Lemma cost_and_r : forall T1 T2 B, cost_spec T2 B -> cost_spec (and T1 T2) B.
Proof. intros T1 T2 B [D [Hg [H1 H2]]]. exists D. split; [ assumption | split ]; [ apply sandr; assumption | assumption ]. Qed.

Lemma cost_r_and_l : forall A B1 B2, cost_spec A B1 -> cost_spec A (and B1 B2).
Proof. intros A B1 B2 [D [Hg [H1 H2]]]. exists D. split; [ assumption | split ]; [ assumption | apply sandl; assumption ]. Qed.

Lemma cost_r_and_r : forall A B1 B2, cost_spec A B2 -> cost_spec A (and B1 B2).
Proof. intros A B1 B2 [D [Hg [H1 H2]]]. exists D. split; [ assumption | split ]; [ assumption | apply sandr; assumption ]. Qed.

Lemma cost_rcd : forall l A0 B0, cost_spec A0 B0 -> cost_spec (rcd l A0) (rcd l B0).
Proof. intros l A0 B0 [D [Hg [H1 H2]]]. exists (rcd l D). split; [ apply GO_rcd; assumption | split; apply srcd; assumption ]. Qed.

Lemma cost_arr : forall CA CB BA BB, cost_spec BA BB -> cost_spec (arr CA BA) (arr CB BB).
Proof.
  intros CA CB BA BB [D [Hg [H1 H2]]].
  exists (arr (and CA CB) D). split; [ apply GO_arrow; assumption | split ].
  - apply sarr; [ apply sandl | assumption ].
  - apply sarr; [ apply sandr | assumption ].
Qed.

(* disjointness descent *)
Lemma disjoint_and_l : forall T1 T2 B, disjoint (and T1 T2) B -> disjoint T1 B.
Proof. intros T1 T2 B H Hc. apply H. apply cost_and_l. assumption. Qed.

Lemma disjoint_and_r : forall T1 T2 B, disjoint (and T1 T2) B -> disjoint T2 B.
Proof. intros T1 T2 B H Hc. apply H. apply cost_and_r. assumption. Qed.

Lemma disjoint_r_and_l : forall A B1 B2, disjoint A (and B1 B2) -> disjoint A B1.
Proof. intros A B1 B2 H Hc. apply H. apply cost_r_and_l. assumption. Qed.

Lemma disjoint_r_and_r : forall A B1 B2, disjoint A (and B1 B2) -> disjoint A B2.
Proof. intros A B1 B2 H Hc. apply H. apply cost_r_and_r. assumption. Qed.

Lemma disjoint_rcd : forall l A0 B0, disjoint (rcd l A0) (rcd l B0) -> disjoint A0 B0.
Proof. intros l A0 B0 H Hc. apply H. apply cost_rcd. assumption. Qed.

Lemma disjoint_arr : forall CA CB BA BB, disjoint (arr CA BA) (arr CB BB) -> disjoint BA BB.
Proof. intros CA CB BA BB H Hc. apply H. apply cost_arr. assumption. Qed.
EOF

(* ================= casting preserves typability ================= *)

Lemma cast_det : forall v, value v -> forall G T, has_type G v inf T ->
  forall C x, casting v C x -> forall y, casting v C y -> x = y.
Proof.
  intros v hv G T Hty C x Hc1 y Hc2.
  eapply cast_det_aux with (n := size_typ C + size_exp v).
  lia. exact hv. exact Hty. exact Hc1. exact Hc2.
Qed.

Lemma casts_consistent : forall v, value v -> forall G T, has_type G v inf T ->
  forall A1 w1, casting v A1 w1 -> forall A2 w2, casting v A2 w2 -> consistencySpec w1 w2.
Proof.
  intros v hv G T Hty A1 w1 H1 A2 w2 H2 C x y Hx Hy.
  pose proof (cast_comp v A1 w1 H1 C x Hx) as Hcx.
  pose proof (cast_comp v A2 w2 H2 C y Hy) as Hcy.
  eapply cast_det; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma casting_typing : forall v A v', casting v A v' -> value v ->
  forall G T, has_type G v inf T -> has_type G v' inf A.
Proof.
  intros v A v' Hc. induction Hc; intros hv G T Hty.
  - (* cast_top *) apply tunit.
  - (* cast_int *) apply tlit.
  - (* cast_mrgl *) inversion hv; subst.
    destruct (merge_typing_left G v1 v2 T Hty) as [T1 [T2 [Heq Hu]]]. subst.
    eapply IHHc; [ exact H1 | exact Hu ].
  - (* cast_mrgr *) inversion hv; subst.
    destruct (merge_typing_right G v1 v2 T Hty) as [G0 [T1 [T2 [Heq Hu]]]]. subst.
    eapply IHHc; [ exact H2 | exact Hu ].
  - (* cast_and *) inversion hv; subst.
    eapply tcon.
    + eapply IHHc1; [ exact H1 | exact Hty ].
    + eapply IHHc2; [ exact H2 | exact Hty ].
    + exact H1.
    + exact H2.
    + eapply casts_consistent; eassumption.
  - (* cast_rcd *) inversion hv; subst.
    destruct (rec_typing_inv G n0 v0 T Hty) as [T0 [Heq Hv0]]. subst.
    apply trec. eapply IHHc; [ exact H0 | exact Hv0 ].
  - (* cast_arr *) inversion hv; subst.
    destruct (box_typing_inv G v0 (ann (lam fm e) (arr A B)) T Hty) as [B1 [Hvt Hann]].
    inversion Hann; subst.
    + exfalso. eapply lam_untypable. eassumption.
    + eapply tbox.
      * exact Hvt.
      * eapply tlam.
        -- eassumption.
        -- eassumption.
        -- eapply sub_trans; [ exact H4 | symmetry; eapply ext_functional; eassumption ].
        -- eapply tsub. exact H5. eassumption.
  - (* cast_arr_tl *) eapply genv_typing. eassumption.
Qed.
EOF

1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user tasked me with proving the declaration `gen_type_safety` in `/workspace/Task.v` for a Rocq 9.1.0 project (calculus with dependent merges). Exact target:
   ```coq
   Theorem gen_type_safety : forall G e m A,
     has_type G e m A -> forall v e',
     value v ->
     has_type top v inf G ->
     v |- e ->* e' ->
     value e' \/ (exists e'', step v e' e'').
   ```
   Explicit rules/constraints (must remain in effect): edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution (helper definitions/lemmas allowed there); keep all supplied definitions and target names/statements/hypotheses unchanged; do not modify support files or `_CoqProject`; do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, `Abort`, `Axiom`, `Parameter`, `Conjecture`, unsafe Rocq flags, or equivalent escape hatches; work offline — no internet, no curl/wget/git clone/HTTP clients, no looking up external proofs; only use supplied input and local libraries; verify with `make` from project root; keep working until the theorem is proven and Task.v compiles or the runner stops, and do not stop merely to report a plan/failure (only report unfinished work if explicitly asked to stop or budget exhausted).

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Rocq/Coq 9.1.0, Metalib, `Program.Equality` (`dependent destruction`), `Lia`.
   - Calculus definitions in Language.v: `typ` (int/top/and/rcd/arr), `mode` (inf/chk), `fmode` (bl/wh), `exp` (lit/unit/ctx/merge/ann/rec/proj/lam/app/box), `sub`, `gord`, `cost_spec`, `disjoint`, `value`, `genv`, `ord`, `toplike`, `ext`, `casting`, `consistencySpec`, `has_type`, `constr`, `step`.
   - Infra.v: `size_typ`, `size_exp`, `star` (inductive reflexive-transitive closure), `irred`.
   - Proof architecture: `Shape` (syntactic canonical value shape by type), `shape_castable` (Shape + sub ⇒ existence of cast), `casting_shape` (cast result has Shape of target), genv canonicity/functionality/typing, `cast_comp` (cast composition), `no_common_cast_aux` (disjoint types cannot both cast to a non-toplike type, proven by strong induction on `size_typ C + size_exp v1 + size_exp v2`), `disjoint_consistency`, `value_typing_indep`, `cast_det_aux`/`cast_det` (determinism by strong induction on `size_typ C + size_exp v`), `casts_consistent` (same-value cast results are consistent via cast_comp + cast_det), `casting_typing` (CastInf: cast result typable at target, proven by induction on the cast derivation with a helper `cast_arr_box_typing`), `value_cast_exists` (totality), `value_dec` (decidability of `value`).
   - SR plan: define `EnvOk G v := value v /\ has_type top v inf G`; prove progress `has_type G e m T -> value v -> value e \/ exists e', step v e e'`; prove preservation at same G/m/T with EnvOk; then star induction plus main theorem. Uses `disjoint_consistency` for typing merged environments and `casting_typing` for beta/ann.

3. Files and Code Sections:

Critical rules include tsub (only chk-producing rule), tmrg/tcon for merge, tlam/tapp/tbox, and step rules (step_ctx, step_annv, step_anne, step_mrgl/mrgr, step_rcde, step_projv/proje, step_switch, step_beta, step_appl/appr, step_boxv/boxe/boxc). cast rules cast_top/int/mrgl/mrgr/and/rcd/arr/arr_tl; genv rules; toplike/ord/ext/constr.

   - `/workspace/W.v` (~1138 lines): the full development. All major lemmas compile except the in-progress `progress` lemma. Key proven declarations include (non-exhaustive):
     - `size_typ_ge1`, `size_exp_ge1`, `sub_refl`, `sub_top_gen`, `sub_and_inv`, `sub_trans`, `sub_toplike`, `toplike_dec`/`toplike_decS`.

     - `value_shape` (value + inf typing ⇒ Shape), `lam_untypable`.
     - `merge_cast_exact`, `merge_cast_exact_r`.
     - `cast_unit_comp`, `cast_comp` (proven by nested induction on first/second cast).

       Lemma progress : forall G e m T, has_type G e m T -> forall v, value v ->

Lemma disjoint_consistency : forall G1 G2 A B v1 v2,
  disjoint A B -> value v1 -> value v2 ->
  has_type G1 v1 inf A -> has_type G2 v2 inf B ->
  consistencySpec v1 v2.
Proof.
  intros G1 G2 A B v1 v2 Hdis hv1 hv2 Ht1 Ht2 C w1 w2 Hc1 Hc2.
  destruct (toplike_decS C) as [ht | hnt].
  - pose proof (cast_toplike_genv _ _ _ Hc1 ht) as g1.
    pose proof (cast_toplike_genv _ _ _ Hc2 ht) as g2.

  - exfalso.
    eapply no_common_cast_aux with (n := size_typ C + size_exp v1 + size_exp v2)

                                     (G1 := G1) (A1 := A) (G2 := G2) (A2 := B)
                                     (w1 := w1) (w2 := w2).

Lemma value_typing_indep_inf : forall v, value v -> forall G T, has_type G v inf T -> forall G', has_type G' v inf T.
Proof.
  intros v Hv. induction Hv; intros G T Hty G'.
  - inversion Hty; subst; apply tlit.
  - inversion Hty; subst; apply tunit.
  - inversion Hty; subst.
    + (* tmrg *) eapply tcon.
      * apply (IHHv1 G A H1).
      * apply (IHHv2 (and G A) B H2).
      * exact Hv1.
      * exact Hv2.

    + (* tcon *) eapply tcon; [ apply (IHHv1 G A H1) | apply (IHHv2 G B H2) | exact Hv1 | exact Hv2 | assumption ].
  - inversion Hty; subst. apply trec. eapply IHHv; eassumption.
  - inversion Hty; subst. eapply tbox. eapply IHHv; eassumption. eassumption.
  - inversion Hty; subst. eapply tbox. eapply IHHv; eassumption. eassumption.

Lemma casts_consistent : forall v, value v -> forall G T, has_type G v inf T ->
  forall A1 w1, casting v A1 w1 -> forall A2 w2, casting v A2 w2 -> consistencySpec w1 w2.
Proof.
  intros v hv G T Hty A1 w1 H1 A2 w2 H2 C x y Hx Hy.

  pose proof (cast_comp v A2 w2 H2 C y Hy) as Hcy.

Lemma genv_value : forall A v, genv A v -> value v.
Proof.
  intros A v H. induction H.
  - apply vunit.
  - apply vclos. apply vunit.
  - apply vmrg; assumption.
  - apply vrec. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma ext_wh_inv : forall A A', ext A wh A' -> exists l A0, A = rcd l A0 /\ A' = A0.
Proof. intros A A' H. inversion H. eauto. Qed.

Lemma ext_functional : forall A fm A1 A2, ext A fm A1 -> ext A fm A2 -> A1 = A2.
Proof. intros A fm A1 A2 H1 H2. inversion H1; subst; inversion H2; subst; reflexivity. Qed.

(* ================= casting: value and shape ================= *)

Lemma casting_value : forall v A v', casting v A v' -> value v -> value v'.
Proof.
  intros v A v' H. induction H; intros hv.
  - apply vunit.
  - apply vlit.
  - apply IHcasting. inversion hv. assumption.
  - apply IHcasting. inversion hv. assumption.
  - apply vmrg; [ apply IHcasting1 | apply IHcasting2 ]; assumption.
  - apply vrec. apply IHcasting. inversion hv. assumption.
  - (* cast_arr *) inversion hv; subst.
    + apply vclos. assumption.
    + apply vsclos. assumption.
  - eapply genv_value. eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma casting_shape : forall v A v', casting v A v' -> Shape A v'.
Proof.
  intros v A v' H. induction H; simpl.
  - (* cast_top *) reflexivity.
  - (* cast_int *) exists i; reflexivity.
  - (* cast_mrgl *) assumption.
  - (* cast_mrgr *) assumption.
  - (* cast_and *) exists v1, v2; auto.
  - (* cast_rcd *) exists v'; auto.
  - (* cast_arr *)
    exists v, e, fm, A, A'. split; [ reflexivity | ].
    split; [ assumption | ]. split; [ exact H1 | ]. split; [ exact H2 | ].
    inversion H1; subst.
    + apply vclos. assumption.
    + apply vsclos. assumption.
  - (* cast_arr_tl *)
    inversion H4; subst.
    exists unit, v0, bl, C, C. split; [ reflexivity | ].
    split; [ constructor | ]. split; [ constructor | ]. split; [ apply sub_refl | ].
    apply vclos. apply vunit.
Qed.

(* ================= toplike and genv ================= *)

Lemma toplike_genv : forall A, toplike A -> exists v, genv A v.
Proof.
  intros A H. induction H.
  - exists unit. apply genv_top.
  - destruct IHtoplike1 as [v1 g1]. destruct IHtoplike2 as [v2 g2].
    exists (merge v1 v2). apply genv_and; assumption.
  - destruct IHtoplike as [v g]. exists (box unit (ann (lam bl v) (arr A B))).
    apply genv_arr. assumption.
  - destruct IHtoplike as [v g]. exists (rec x v). apply genv_rcd. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma toplike_dec : forall A, toplike A \/ ~ toplike A.
Proof.
  induction A; simpl.
  - right. intro H. inversion H.
  - left. apply TL_top.
  - destruct IHA1 as [h1|h1]; destruct IHA2 as [h2|h2].
    + left. apply TL_and; assumption.
    + right. intro H. inversion H. tauto.
    + right. intro H. inversion H. tauto.
    + right. intro H. inversion H. tauto.
  - destruct IHA as [h|h].
    + left. apply TL_rcd. assumption.
    + right. intro H. inversion H. tauto.
  - destruct IHA2 as [h|h].
    + left. apply TL_arr. assumption.
    + right. intro H. inversion H. tauto.
Qed.

(* ================= Shape implies castability ================= *)

Lemma sub_top_gord_false : forall C, gord C -> sub top C -> False.
Proof.
  intros C Hg. induction Hg as [| A B HgB IHgB | l B HgB IHgB]; intros Hs.
  - inversion Hs.
  - inversion Hs.
  - inversion Hs.
Qed.

Lemma disjoint_top_l : forall A, disjoint top A.
Proof.
  intros A [C [Hg [H1 H2]]]. eapply sub_top_gord_false; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma disjoint_top_r : forall A, disjoint A top.
Proof.
  intros A [C [Hg [H1 H2]]]. eapply sub_top_gord_false; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma non_toplike_gord : forall A, ~ toplike A -> exists D, gord D /\ sub A D.
Proof.
  induction A; intros hnt.
  - exists int. split; [ apply GO_int | apply sint ].
  - exfalso. apply hnt. apply TL_top.
  - destruct (toplike_dec A1) as [h1 | h1].
    + destruct (toplike_dec A2) as [h2 | h2].
      * exfalso. apply hnt. apply TL_and; assumption.
      * destruct (IHA2 h2) as [D [Hg Hs]]. exists D. split; [ assumption | ].
        apply sandr. assumption.
    + destruct (IHA1 h1) as [D [Hg Hs]]. exists D. split; [ assumption | ].
      apply sandl. assumption.
  - destruct (IHA (fun h => hnt (TL_rcd n A h))) as [D [Hg Hs]].
    exists (rcd n D). split; [ apply GO_rcd; assumption | apply srcd; assumption ].
  - destruct (IHA2 (fun h => hnt (TL_arr A1 A2 h))) as [D [Hg Hs]].
    exists (arr A1 D). split; [ apply GO_arrow; assumption | ].
    apply sarr; [ apply sub_refl | assumption ].

  - inversion Hg.
  - inversion Hg; subst. eapply IHcasting; eassumption.
  - inversion Hg; subst. eapply IHcasting; eassumption.

    exfalso. eapply H0. apply sub_toplike with (A:=B).

  - inversion Hg; subst. assumption.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros A v1 H1 B v2 H2 C w1 w2 Hc1 Hc2.
  pose proof (genv_cast_genv _ _ _ Hc1 _ H1) as g1.
  pose proof (genv_cast_genv _ _ _ Hc2 _ H2) as g2.
  assert (w1 = w2) by (eapply genv_functional; eassumption). assumption.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros A v H. induction H; intros G.
  - apply tunit.
  - (* arr *) eapply tbox.

      * apply sub_refl.

    + apply IHgenv2.

  - (* rcd *) apply trec. apply IHgenv.

  - apply IHcasting. assumption.

  - apply genv_rcd. apply IHcasting. inversion ht; subst; assumption.
  - exfalso. apply H0. apply toplike_arr_inv in ht. assumption.
  - assumption.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros v1 v2 B. induction B; intros x Hc.
  - apply cast_mrgl; [ exact Hc | apply O_int ].
  - inversion Hc; subst; try apply cast_top;
    try (exfalso; match goal with H : ord top |- _ => inversion H end).

    + exfalso. match goal with H : ord (and _ _) |- _ => inversion H end.

  - apply cast_mrgl; [ exact Hc | apply O_rcd ].
  - apply cast_mrgl; [ exact Hc | apply O_arrow ].
Qed.

Lemma merge_cast_exact_r : forall v1 v2 B x, casting v2 B x -> casting (merge v1 v2) B x.
Proof.

  - apply cast_mrgr; [ exact Hc | apply O_rcd ].
  - apply cast_mrgr; [ exact Hc | apply O_arrow ].
Qed.

  intros v A v' H1. induction H1; intros T w Hc.
